description.text:
The Kitakami Special Pack (北上乡专题包) is a five-card holo pack sold only in the four Ogerpon gift boxes (厄诡椪系列礼盒), on sale from 15 May 2026. Its cards show the Pokémon and people of Kitakami, the mountain village that holds the old Festival of Masks (掩面祭): Ogerpon, Okidogi, Munkidori, Fezandipiti and Pecharunt, and trainers such as Carmine. Each pack holds three Pokémon holos, with luck an art illustration of Teal Mask Ogerpon or Pecharunt; one Pokémon ex holo, with luck a special Teal Mask Ogerpon ex; and one Trainer holo, with luck a Special Art Rare of Carmine asking someone to share food with her at the festival.

The four gift boxes, Teal Mask, Hearthflame Mask, Wellspring Mask and Cornerstone Mask, each held one Kitakami Special Pack, three 20-card Brilliant Illusions packs and three 20-card Stellar Crystal packs, with 64 sleeves, a coin die, a fridge magnet and a card box in that mask's style and four damage-counter dice. Pokémon China noted that the pack's Teal, Hearthflame, Wellspring and Cornerstone Mask Ogerpon cards with regulation mark I could be used at official events in every current format. Its cards are numbered out of 40; the two art illustrations, the special Ogerpon ex and Carmine's Special Art Rare are numbered 041 to 044.

sources.title: Pokémon China: The Ogerpon gift boxes and the Kitakami Special Pack (17 April 2026)
